gen-eater-fs-alpino: Menacing and a bit ragged, Eater keeps its strokes thin and its letters spread wide apart. Alpino takes the opposite job, a cozy, tall-bodied sans-serif that stays friendly and casual.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-familjen-grotesk: Wide, loud, and built like a command. Goldman spaces its letters generously with round forms like open parentheses, while Familjen Grotesk adds a lively sans with tall lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-hind: Grandstander is all bold, expressive energy, with short ascenders and a tall x-height in lines of constant width. Hind follows in a sober sans, so give it a comfortable size and let it carry the text.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-work-sans: Love Ya Like A Sister is loose and expressive, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height and its terminals flicking outward. Work Sans steps in as a modern plain sans, and its high mean line gives the page a firm footing.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-general-sans: Snowburst One cuts its bold lowercase like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges between the letters. General Sans below it can go a touch larger.
gen-luckiest-guy-poppins: Poppins reads modern and clean, with loose curves and a sturdy, tall lowercase that never fusses over thick and thin strokes. Luckiest Guy brings the cheerful shouting on top.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-amulya: Happy Monkey draws every line ruler-straight, with wide gaps in the e. Its loud shapes handle the attention-grabbing, while Amulya, a modern sans-serif with generous curves, handles the quiet work of the text.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-chillax: Chillax reads like a relaxed plain sans, its curves lifted off the page and left loose like spaghetti. Under Happy Monkey, a longer text would feel easygoing, never stiff.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-plein: Straight-edged and a little cheeky. Happy Monkey sets bold, ruler-straight lines above Plein, a reliable sans whose clear channel into each round letter keeps the text easy to follow.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans is approachable and contemporary, with wide gaps where curves meet stems and strokes of identical weight. Against Happy Monkey, that restraint is the pair's strongest quality.
